I've written the screening record and re-checked each file:line I cite against the pinned tree; nothing was run.

- **Output:** `/home/mara/cwe-bench/sibling2/out/screener/19150.json`
- **Trust decision:** text from the OpenAPI spec (server description, URL, variable default) goes into generated Go comments and string literals. `server-urls.tmpl` inserted it unescaped, and `StringToGoString` (`pkg/codegen/utils.go:909-912`) escaped only `"`, so a backslash before a quote got past it.
- **`pattern_fit`:** A+B.
- **Strongest lever:** the server-URL enum values. `serverURLEnumKeys` (`pkg/codegen/server_urls.go:186-199`) turns them into Go names without cleaning them, and `constants.tmpl:12` wraps the values in bare quotes. That code lives in the shared enum pipeline, not the server-URL template, so a solver can easily call it "a different feature". Variable names in `server-urls.tmpl:63-75` and in the parameter list are also still unescaped after the fix.
- **Biggest red flag:** none of the listed flags apply. The main open risk is that I didn't check whether the spec loader (kin-openapi) already rejects quotes or newlines in variable names and enum values; if it does, some of the uncovered routes fall away. Repo size wasn't measured either.
